hypothesis: H3: In early Warlock board fights, the single three-mana random Deadly Shot often cannot precisely remove a two-health key attacker while also developing a minion. Replace only that card at slot 23 with a second one-mana Arcane Shot; keep the other 29 slots, all tactics, mulligan and search budgets identical to DARCL2. Predict positive fresh Astra macro gain from more precise clear-plus-development opportunities. Refute with nonpositive natural full-game gain, failed independent confirmation, or excessive loss of large-target removal in the frozen guardrail. This is the only new card substitution tested this sprint, not an assertion that card exposure implies causal value.
evidence_summary: Unscreened 600 seen Astra games: precise key-clear opportunity with Deadly Shot in hand 132 games, including 45 original losses; paired Flame Imp clear subgroup 6 rescues / 0 regressions across 5 positive source seeds, development-only.
negative_control: Healthy taunts, Amani and larger bodies exceed Arcane Shot damage; compare original wins that become losses before further work.
mulligan_unchanged: Opening diagnostics did not establish a general opening failure; no repeat of the failed trap-keep rule.
